description: Look up the digital footprint of a phone number via SEON: carrier and line type, validity, and which online/social/account platforms the number is linked to. Example: seon_phone({ phone: "+13106667777", _apiKey: "your-seon-license-key" })

_apiKey.description: SEON license key (sign up at https://seon.io/pricing/)

config.description: Optional SEON config object (see docs). Passed through verbatim.

phone.description: Phone number in E.164 format, e.g. "+13106667777"

name: seon_phone
